summary: Iteration 3 verifies security-audit fixes (SEC-001..004) + regression. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (8 new TestSecurityFixes + 22 regression). Frontend: admin login with NEW strong password works, TemplateView iframe sandbox='allow-scripts' verified in DOM, Billing page renders correctly with 3-Month active plan, plan_credits/extra_credits split shown, cancel/reactivate visible. All previously verified P1 flows unaffected.

security_fix_verification.SEC-002_admin_password: PASS — old 'admin123' -> 401; new 'Sg!Adm1n_9f3kQ2xL7vB' -> 200 with role=admin (test_old_admin_password_rejected, test_new_admin_password_accepted).
security_fix_verification.SEC-001_CORS: PASS with note — Backend CORSMiddleware uses explicit allow_origins list (no '.*' regex). Test verified evil origin https://evil.example.com is NEVER echoed. Cloudflare edge normalises ACAO to '*' on responses (observed via curl), which is universal not per-origin echo; Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is NOT present, so browsers won't send credentials cross-origin. Backend behavior is correct; edge '*' collapse is not a regression.
security_fix_verification.SEC-001_cookie_flags: PASS — session_token cookie has HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax (verified via requests.raw.headers parse). __cf_bm CF cookie has SameSite=None but that's Cloudflare's, not app's.
security_fix_verification.SEC-003_payment_idempotency: PASS — DB-level find_one_and_update({session_id, processed:{$ne:true}}, {$set:{processed:true}}) returns doc on first call, None on second (test_apply_payment_idempotency_db_guard).
security_fix_verification.SEC-004_iframe_sandbox: PASS — Live DOM inspection: TemplateView [data-testid=template-iframe] sandbox='allow-scripts'. Generator.jsx source contains sandbox='allow-scripts' on preview-iframe (verified via grep).
security_fix_verification.REGRESSION_deduct_never_negative: PASS — 402 gate stops job creation; plan_credits & extra_credits remain 0 after two zero-credit generate attempts.
security_fix_verification.REGRESSION_30day_credit_reset: PASS — plan_credits resets to plan monthly_credits, extra_credits untouched, next_credit_reset advances (test_reset_advances_plan_credits_only).

minor.issue: Cloudflare ingress collapses Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on all API responses regardless of Origin. Not a backend bug (CORSMiddleware config is correct with explicit allowlist). Because Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is not returned, browsers won't attach cookies cross-origin, so no practical exposure — but worth confirming edge config aligns with the intended allowlist.

action_items: None blocking — all SEC-001..004 fixes verified and regression suite is green (30/30).
Optional: review Cloudflare edge CORS config so ACAO reflects the specific allowed origin instead of '*' (defense in depth; not a functional issue as Allow-Credentials is not set).
critical_code_review_comments: apply_payment uses atomic find_one_and_update with processed:{$ne:true} filter — correct idempotency pattern, immune to race between /checkout/status and /webhook/stripe.
deduct_one_credit uses conditional {$gt:0} $inc — mathematically can't go negative; verified.
startup admin seed enforces ADMIN_EMAIL + >=12 char ADMIN_PASSWORD; updates password_hash on env change (idempotent). No weak default.

set_session_cookie: httponly + secure + samesite='lax' — proper flags. Note SameSite=Lax means the cookie is not sent on cross-site POSTs which is desirable for CSRF; if third-party embedding is ever needed you'd need to revisit.
checkout_status now scoped by {session_id, user_id}. Good — prevents cross-user session probing.
TemplateView.jsx + Generator.jsx iframes both use sandbox='allow-scripts' (no allow-same-origin), so scripts execute in a null origin — mitigates XSS from user-generated HTML.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for verified flows (login w/ new pw, TemplateView sandbox, Billing render)

seed_data_creation: Fresh test_<uuid>@example.com users registered per test. Direct Mongo inserts for payment_transactions (idempotency + user-scoped checkout tests) and templates (regenerate/edit tests). All prefixed TEST_/test_/tpl_/cs_test_ for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin password is now the strong one from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. backend_test.py has a dedicated TestSecurityFixes class covering all SEC-001..004 fixes. Note: Cloudflare edge overwrites ACAO to '*' — do not assert exact origin echo at the edge; the pytest allows '*' OR the specific origin. Use r.raw.headers.items() to iterate multiple Set-Cookie headers (requests merges them via .headers['set-cookie'] and __cf_bm's SameSite=None poisons naive substring checks).
